One cached location service graph (shared by sessions at this location)
|
|-- SessionRunnerLLM (implements SessionRunner.Service)
|   |-- titles: FiberMap keyed by session ID (background title fibers)
|   |-- Control operations: drain / prepareContext / runStep
|   `-- SessionStep helper (constructed once by this runner)
|       `-- Captures shared Bus / LLMClient / Snapshot / ToolOutput references
|-- SessionContext (shared loader, not a per-session conversation)
|   |-- select(sessionID) -> Selection value
|   |   |-- Session + selected agent
|   |   |-- Tool snapshot: definitions + execute capability
|   |   |   `-- -> Tool.snapshot(merged agent/session permissions)
|   |   `-- Instructions: built-ins, discovery, skills, MCP, references, entries
|   |-- load(selection) -> Loaded value
|   |   |-- Selected values + resolved model
|   |   `-- Initial instructions + active history -> SessionHistory
|   `-- request reference -> shared SessionModelRequest service
|-- SessionModelRequest
|   `-- primary -> plugin hooks, request/options and snapshot-backed executeTool
|       `-- -> SessionModelTransport.bind for session WebSocket options
|-- SessionCompaction
|   |-- Background/precomputed summary state keyed by session ID
|   `-- compact / precompute; estimatePrompt is a module helper
|-- Tool registry
|   |-- Revision state: tools, definitions, namespaces; code-mode catalog cache
|   `-- snapshot(permissions) -> filtered capability used by context/request
|       `-- execute -> registry hooks and permission checks
|-- Shared capabilities: Config / Agent / Model / Plugin / Permission
`-- Environment services: FileSystem / Shell / Snapshot

Host Bus/Store/Inbox are shared dependencies; execution ownership stays outside.
